title: March meetup: Postgres indexing war stories
description:
March meetup: Postgres indexing war stories

Our monthly get-together is back. Two short talks on query plans and partial indexes, then pizza.

  • When: Thursday, 12 March 2026
  • Doors: 18:30 · Talks start: 19:00
  • Where: Galata Tech Hub, Karaköy, Istanbul

Attendance is free, but seats are limited — please RSVP.

title: Applied ML Summit 2026
description:
Applied ML Summit 2026

14–15 May 2026 • Berlin

Two days, three tracks and more than 40 talks on putting machine learning models into production: evaluation, monitoring, and LLM applications.

Schedule, day one

Registration opens at 08:15. Opening keynote at 09:00.

Tickets

Early bird: €249 (until 1 April)
Regular: €349
Student: €120 with valid ID

Venue: Spreehalle Kongress, Berlin-Friedrichshain. This is an in-person event; talks will not be streamed.

title: Free webinar: Budgeting basics for freelancers
description:
Irregular income makes budgeting harder, not impossible. In this 60-minute online session we walk through a simple system for setting aside tax, building a buffer, and paying yourself a steady salary.

Tuesday 3 March, 17:00 CET. Live online; the link is sent after registration. There is no charge to attend.

You will mostly be listening, with 15 minutes for questions at the end.

title: Seramik Atölyesi: Çark ile Tanışma
description:
Hiç çamura dokunmadıysanız bu atölye tam size göre. Üç saat boyunca çarkta kendi kasenizi şekillendireceksiniz; fırınlama bizden.

Tarih: 21 Mart Cumartesi
Saat: 14.00 - 17.00
Yer: Alsancak, İzmir

Katılım ücreti kişi başı 750 TL'dir, tüm malzemeler dahildir. Kontenjan 8 kişiyle sınırlıdır.

title: Transit App Hack Weekend
description:
Build a web or mobile app on top of the city's open transport API in 30 hours. Form a team of up to four, pick a challenge, and demo your prototype on Sunday afternoon.

StartsSaturday 18 April 2026, 10:00
DemosSunday 19 April, 16:00
LocationWerfkade Lab, Amsterdam — or join remotely via our video rooms
CostFree for all participants (food included on site)

Remote teams are welcome and compete in the same tracks.

title: Ulusal Amatör Astronomi Buluşması: Tarihi Not Edin
description:
İki günlük buluşmamız bu sonbaharda yine Ankara'da! Gözlem teknikleri, astrofotoğrafçılık ve bilim iletişimi üzerine konuşmalardan oluşan programımız üzerinde çalışıyoruz.

Kesin tarih, mekân ve kayıt koşulları önümüzdeki haftalarda duyurulacaktır. Konuşma önerilerinizi 30 Haziran'a kadar gönderebilirsiniz.

title: Friday social 5K + coffee
description:
Easy-paced 5K along the river path, all abilities welcome. We meet this Friday at 7 pm outside the boathouse in Putney, London, and finish at the café.

£8 per runner, payable on the day (covers your coffee and a pastry). Bring a friend!

title: UrbanClimate 2026: Call for Papers
description:
Call for Papers

We invite submissions for UrbanClimate 2026, the 9th international conference on heat, air quality and adaptation in cities.

Abstract submission deadline15 June 2026
Notification of acceptance1 July 2026
Early registration closes31 July 2026
Conference9–11 September 2026, Munich

Registration fees: regular €420, student €90. Fees include lunches and the conference dinner.

All sessions take place on site at the university's main campus; there is no remote participation option.

title: Portfolio Teardown: live UX workshop
description:
Bring one case study and leave with a sharper story. In this small-group, hands-on workshop you will rewrite your project intro, restructure a case study, and get direct feedback from two senior designers.

Saturday, June 6, 2026 · 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM Central Time

The workshop runs entirely online in a live video room; a recording is not provided. $49 per seat, limited to 12 participants.

Pixel & Grid is a two-person design studio based in Austin, Texas.

title: Data & AI Night #17
description:
Data & AI Night #17

Three lightning talks: feature stores in practice, evaluating RAG pipelines, and a post-mortem of a failed A/B test.

Wed 25 March 2026, 18:45 • Hinterhof Loft, Berlin

Tickets: €12 (includes one drink). Get your ticket
